0.text: Fassith: Be quiet you oaf! Someone will hear us!
General C: I don’t care, why shouldn’t the whole world know? I’m tired of hating you.

1.text: Fassith: I know, I know, but if anyone were to connect things…

2.text: General C: Bah! To hell with Archibald, the old clown. He can stay in exile for all I care.

3.text: Fassith: Reinstating Archibald is the only way we can ever go public with our feelings!

4.text: General C: Well, then what are we waiting for? I’ll send someone to kill that bastard Roma, right now!

5.text: Fassith: You do that and you betray the goddess herself. No. The only way this works is if Roma survives his removal. Otherwise we risk the wrath of the High Pope…
